name: figure-notes
description: A figure in the main region with a column of notes beside it, a title band on top and a footer for sources.

regions.name: title
regions.description: Title band across the canvas (the slide's `title` sugar goes here).

regions.name: main
regions.description: The figure. A single element fills the region's height.

regions.name: notes
regions.description: Notes column to the right of the figure; elements stack vertically, centered.

regions.name: footer
regions.description: Footer line across the canvas, typically a source line.

variables.name: --notes-gap
variables.description: Space between the figure and the notes column.
